study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Sampaio et al., Artificial Intelligence in Medicine, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: A generalizable normative deep autoencoder for brain morphological anomaly detection: application to the multi-site StratiBip dataset on bipolar disorder in an external validation framework

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: HCP-YA (Human Connectome Project Young Adult, 1200 Subjects Data Release, S1200 Release March 2017) was used as the normative training set. The StratiBip dataset, a multi-site clinical dataset from the StratiBip/ENPACT network consisting of 7 sites across Europe and Canada, was used as the external test set. StratiBip does not correspond to any named dataset in the reference list, so it is classified as MULTI-SITE (N>=2) with N=7 sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Our training set was obtained from the HCP-YA public dataset, 1200 Subjects Data Release (S12000 Release, March 2017)" ; "The external test set consisted of data collected as part of the StratiBip network, an initiative that originated from the ENPACT network" ; "The sMRI data used as external test set was acquired from 550 subjects...across 7 sites using T1-weighted sequences on 3 T MRI scanners."

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): external testing (HC and BD for anomaly detection)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The HCP-YA dataset (1109 HC) was used exclusively for training the deep autoencoder normative model. After 10-fold CV hyperparameter tuning, the best AE model was re-trained on the entire HCP-YA training set. The StratiBip multi-site dataset (363 HC + 187 BD = 550 subjects) served as the external test set for evaluating normative deviations. The StratiBip HC portion was also used in the M-ComBat harmonization pipeline to estimate site effects jointly with HCP-YA.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The normative model framework was trained on the confounders-free brain features extracted from the human connectome project young adults (HCP-YA) dataset and applied to multi-site data from the StratiBip network, including HC and subjects with BD." ; "After hyperparameter tunning, the best AE model was re-trained on the entire HCP-YA training set."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was built using the entire HCP-YA healthy control dataset of 1109 subjects. There is no separate held-out normative validation or test set; the model was trained on all 1109 HCP-YA subjects after hyperparameter tuning via 10-fold CV. The StratiBip test set (363 HC + 187 BD) was used as an external test set and is not part of the normative model construction.

Values are reported in years.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The entire HCP-YA dataset was used as training, so overall and train phases are identical. Female: 604/1109 = 54.5%; Male: 505/1109 = 45.5%. No significant sex differences were found among the three groups (HCP-YA, StratiBip-HC, StratiBip-BD) per Chi-Square test (p=0.728).
